name: Local Form Backend (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted form submission backend for static sites and small apps. Runs on Node.js 22.13+ with SQLite or Docker; provides per-form HTTP endpoints, admin submission inbox, CSV export, optional SMTP/webhook notifications, honeypot and per-IP/per-form rate limiting. No vendor-enforced license expiry or hosted submission quota; software runs on infrastructure you supply.
watch_out: No managed hosted service, VPS, storage, SMTP or email delivery allowance is included. Bring your own infrastructure and SMTP/webhook providers, which may have charges or separate quotas. Default per-form anti-abuse limits include 10 submissions per minute per IP and 64 KiB request bodies; these are application controls, not free-tier allowances. Before production, set a strong persistent ADMIN_TOKEN, configure HTTPS/reverse proxy and BASE_URL, persist and back up SQLite data, and set TRUST_PROXY only behind a trusted proxy. Repository production instructions have not been independently deployment-tested.
